_rule: Each chatbot is represented by the API model closest to what its FREE consumer app gives a student by default (decided 2026-11-02). Before the full run, Advaith confirms in each free app which model it shows, and these entries are re-checked. Any change here is logged in prereg/decisions.md.

chatgpt.app_check: 2026-11-04, Advaith, free account, new chat: the app identified the model as 'GPT-6'. OpenAI's Oct 7, 2026 release note says Free and Go use 'GPT-6 Luna' (paid tiers use GPT-6 Sol). Entry changed from gpt-5.6-luna to gpt-6-luna on 2026-11-04 (D25).
chatgpt.caveat: OpenAI's Free Tier FAQ still said GPT-5.6 Luna on 2026-11-02; the release notes and the app check both say GPT-6. The app showed 'GPT-6' without the 'Luna' suffix; Luna is inferred from the release note. API reasoning effort is left at its default, 'medium'.

gemini.free_app_default: Auto (most prompts use Flash-Lite; harder prompts may go to Flash or Pro)
gemini.app_check: 2026-11-04, Advaith, free account, new chat: model menu showed 'Gemini Auto (Gemini 3 models)'. Consistent with this entry.
gemini.caveat: The app's Auto routing can't be reproduced through the API, and Google's help page doesn't name the Flash-Lite version. gemini-3.5-flash-lite is the newest Flash-Lite in the API docs.

claude.app_check: 2026-11-04, Advaith, free account, new chat: picker showed 'Sonnet 5.5' with effort 'medium'. Confirmed. API calls therefore set output_config.effort = 'medium' (D24); the API default would be 'high'.
claude.caveat: The app's 'medium' is assumed to correspond to the API's effort level 'medium'. Anthropic does not publish the exact mapping.

echo.caveat: Fake model for testing the pipeline without API calls. Never part of the study.
